idea-plugin.name: Ad Integration Pro
idea-plugin.description:
Ad Integration Pro

Ad Integration Pro makes adding ads to your Android apps fast, simple, and error-free. No more manual Gradle edits, Manifest tweaks, or endless copy-pasting SDK code — this plugin automates the entire setup process.

Features

  • Multi-provider support: Google AdMob, Unity Ads, Facebook Audience, IronSource
  • Ad formats: Banner, Interstitial, Rewarded, Native
  • Automatic setup: Gradle dependencies & AndroidManifest updated
  • Helper class: AdHelper.java / AdHelper.kt
  • Smart detection: Generates Java or Kotlin code automatically
  • Boilerplate methods included: initAds(), showBanner(), showInterstitial(), showRewarded(), showNative()

How It Works

  1. Open your Android project
  2. Go to Tools → Ad Integration Assistant
  3. Select your ad provider
  4. Choose the ad formats
  5. Click OK — your project is ready

Why Choose Ad Integration Pro?

  • Eliminates hours of manual setup
  • Reduces common integration errors
  • Works seamlessly with Java and Kotlin
  • Auto-generates clean and reusable helper classes

Example Usage


        val adHelper = AdHelper(this)
        adHelper.initAds()
        adHelper.showBanner(this)

Requirements

  • Android Studio / IntelliJ IDEA 2023.1 or later
  • Minimum Android SDK 21

Free Features

  • Google AdMob
  • Banner Ads
  • Interstitial Ads
  • Automatic Gradle setup
  • Automatic Manifest setup
  • Java/Kotlin helper generation

Pro Features

  • Unity Ads
  • Facebook Audience Network
  • IronSource
  • Rewarded Ads
  • Native Ads

Support
